systems.name: Employees Retirement System of Texas

statute.quote: "Retirement system" means the Employees Retirement System of Texas.

body.name: board of trustees of the Employees Retirement System of Texas

source.quote: The board of trustees is responsible for the general administration and operation of the retirement system.

website_source.quote: The Employees Retirement System of Texas (ERS) manages benefits for employees and retirees of State of Texas agencies and some higher education institutions.

systems.notes: Census lists the Law Enforcement and Custodial Officer Supplemental Retirement Fund (LECOS) separately; it is an ERS fund (Gov't Code § 815.317). The system itself rests on Tex. Const. art. XVI, § 67; Gov't Code § 815.310 establishes its trust fund.

systems.name: Texas Emergency Services Retirement System

source.quote: The state board of the pension system is composed of nine members appointed by the governor for staggered terms of six years
